notes: polyA polya.sv40 was auto-selected as the most compact functional signal (135 bp). Alternatives: polya.bgh (225 bp). Set polya_preference to choose one.
include_wpre was requested but WPRE (enhancer.wpre, 589 bp) was omitted because adding it would take the cassette to 5,653 bp against the 4,700 bp target. The cassette is 5,064 bp without it.

checks.label: Packaging limit
checks.message: Cassette is 5,064 bp. The single stranded packaging target is 4,700 bp, so the design is 364 bp over the target, 164 bp above the 4,900 bp soft limit, and 136 bp under the hard ceiling of 5,200 bp. One change closes it: replace CAG (promoter.cag, 1,639 bp) with EFS (promoter.efs, 212 bp), which saves 1,427 bp, bringing the cassette to 3,637 bp, 1,063 bp under the 4,700 bp target. EFS is annotated ubiquitous like CAG, so tissue specificity is preserved. Registry note: The compact ubiquitous option. Weaker than CAG. Alternative: replace CAG (promoter.cag, 1,639 bp) with CMV (promoter.cmv, 663 bp), which saves 976 bp, giving 4,088 bp, 612 bp under the target. No option keeps the stated promoter preference promoter.cag: the savings available without touching the promoter total 0 bp against a 364 bp overage, so the promoter has to change or the transgene has to shrink to at most 4,063 bp. 4 ranked options are reported in the structured remediation field. This is a failure rather than a warning because the cassette is above the 4,900 bp soft limit.
checks.threshold: target 4,700 bp, soft limit 4,900 bp, hard limit 5,200 bp
checks.citation: System design section 6.5 (banded packaging limit). Wild-type AAV2 genome NC_001401.2 is 4,679 bp; the capsid ceiling sits near that size. The band exists because the practical ceiling is contested in the literature.

Registry note: The compact ubiquitous option. Weaker than CAG.

Registry note: Strong, ubiquitous expression. Can silence over time in some tissues (Appendix B).

Registry note: Hybrid, ubiquitous (Appendix B). The CBh promoter is described in a 2011 Human Gene Therapy paper as a hybrid form of the chicken beta-actin promoter of roughly 800 bp.

Registry note: Ubiquitous, durable expression (Appendix B). Contains the EFS core promoter sequence within it.

checks.label: Both ITRs present and matched
checks.message: Both ITRs are present and match the AAV2 reference above the 95% threshold (5' ITR 100.0% identity to itr.aav2_itr_left (as written); 3' ITR 100.0% identity to itr.aav2_itr_right (as written)). Each ITR was compared with the serotype reference records in both orientations, not with the other ITR, because the left ITR reads core plus D and the right reads reverse complement of D plus core, so that comparison scores only 88.3 percent even when both ITRs are correct. Keep the registry records as they are.
checks.observed: 5' ITR 100.0% identity to itr.aav2_itr_left (as written); 3' ITR 100.0% identity to itr.aav2_itr_right (as written)
checks.threshold: 95% identity to the serotype reference
checks.citation: System design section 6.2 (ITRs are required in cis for replication and packaging) and section 6.5 (ITR_IDENTITY_THRESHOLD). Reference ITRs: NC_001401.2 positions 1..145 and 4535..4679, see data/parts/PROVENANCE.md.

checks.label: ITR orientation
checks.message: The ITRs are inverted relative to each other, which is the required arrangement: the 20 bp D element faces inward in both ITRs: it reads at the 3' end of the 5' ITR (100.0% identity) and its reverse complement reads at the 5' end of the 3' ITR (100.0% identity). No change is needed.
checks.threshold: inverted arrangement required
checks.citation: System design section 6.4 check 3. ITR terminal repeat structure including the D element: Srivastava and colleagues, Journal of Virology 1983, 45:555-564 (doi:10.1128/JVI.45.2.555-564.1983).

checks.label: Self complementary capacity
checks.message: The design is single stranded, so the halved self complementary capacity does not apply and the 4,700 bp single stranded target was used by aav.packaging_limit instead. If you switch to self complementary, the cassette would be measured against 2,400 bp, and at 5,064 bp it would be 2,664 bp over that target, so the cassette would have to shrink first. No change is needed for the current single stranded design.
checks.threshold: target 2,400 bp, soft limit 2,500 bp, hard limit 2,600 bp
checks.citation: System design section 6.2 (self complementary genomes are effectively duplicated, halving usable capacity) and section 6.5 self complementary band.

checks.threshold: promoter tissue_specificity in {ubiquitous} for target ubiquitous
checks.citation: System design section 6.2 (promoter choice encodes tissue specificity) and section 6.4 check 8. Promoter annotations from data/parts, each with its own citation.

checks.label: Internal direct repeats
checks.message: 1 direct repeat(s) longer than 20 bp occur in the 4,774 bp region between the two ITRs. The longest is 21 bp, present at cassette positions 159 and 352 (in promoter (CAG promoter (CMV enhancer, chicken beta-actin promoter and intron)) and promoter (CAG promoter (CMV enhancer, chicken beta-actin promoter and intron))). Direct repeats in the same orientation are recombination substrates during vector production and yield deleted species, so this lowers the fraction of full length genomes. Either accept it, which is normal for standard parts (the 21 bp sequence ACGGTAAATGGCCCGCCTGGC occurs twice inside promoter.cmv, promoter.cag and promoter.cbh because all three carry the repeated CMV enhancer motif), or substitute a part that does not carry the repeat: promoter.efs, promoter.ef1a, promoter.gfap, promoter.hsyn1 and promoter.mecp2_mini carry none. This is a Tier B warning, not a failure.
checks.threshold: no direct repeat longer than 20 bp
checks.citation: System design section 6.4 check 9 and MAX_DIRECT_REPEAT_BP in section 6.5. Direct repeats are recombination substrates during vector production.

checks.label: Homopolymer runs
checks.message: 1 homopolymer run(s) longer than 8 bp occur inside the cassette. The longest is 14 consecutive G at cassette position 558 inside promoter (CAG promoter (CMV enhancer, chicken beta-actin promoter and intron)). Long single base runs destabilise synthesis and replication and are a common cause of indels in the ordered DNA. If the run sits in your own transgene, break it with synonymous codon changes. If it sits in a registry part, it is expected and documented: promoter.cag carries a 14 bp G run and promoter.cbh a 16 bp G run in their GC rich cores. This is a Tier B warning, not a failure.
checks.threshold: no single base run longer than 8 bp
checks.citation: System design section 6.4 check 10 and MAX_HOMOPOLYMER_RUN in section 6.5. Long homopolymers destabilise synthesis and replication.

checks.label: Kozak initiation context
checks.message: The initiator ATG sits in a strong Kozak context: a purine (A) at -3 and G at +4, reading GGCAAAATGG. No change is needed. The full GCCRCCATGG consensus is not matched at every position, which is common and not a problem once -3 and +4 are right.
checks.observed: -3 is A, +4 is G, context GGCAAAATGG
checks.threshold: purine (A or G) at -3 and G at +4; full consensus GCCRCCATGG
checks.citation: System design section 6.4 check 11. Initiation consensus and the -3 and +4 hierarchy: Kozak, Nucleic Acids Research 1987, 15:8125-8148 (doi:10.1093/nar/15.20.8125).

checks.label: Functional polyadenylation signal
checks.message: The polyA element (SV40 polyadenylation signal, 135 bp) carries a recognised polyadenylation hexamer: AATAAA at position 32 of the element, cassette position 4,816, and 1 further occurrence(s). No change is needed.
checks.threshold: one of AATAAA, ATTAAA present in the polyA element
checks.citation: System design section 6.4 check 12. AATAAA: Proudfoot and Brownlee, Nature 1976, 263:211-214. ATTAAA variant usage: Beaudoing and colleagues, Genome Research 2000, 10:1001-1010.

checks.label: Minimum genome size

checks.threshold: at least 2,000 bp
checks.citation: System design section 6.4 check 13 and AAV_MIN_GENOME_BP in section 6.5. Below the minimum, packaging efficiency degrades and the empty capsid fraction rises.

changes.tradeoff: EFS is annotated ubiquitous like CAG, so tissue specificity is preserved. Registry note: The compact ubiquitous option. Weaker than CAG.
CMV is annotated ubiquitous like CAG, so tissue specificity is preserved. Registry note: Strong, ubiquitous expression. Can silence over time in some tissues (Appendix B).

CBH is annotated ubiquitous like CAG, so tissue specificity is preserved. Registry note: Hybrid, ubiquitous (Appendix B). The CBh promoter is described in a 2011 Human Gene Therapy paper as a hybrid form of the chicken beta-actin promoter of roughly 800 bp.
EF1A is annotated ubiquitous like CAG, so tissue specificity is preserved. Registry note: Ubiquitous, durable expression (Appendix B). Contains the EFS core promoter sequence within it.
